vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm came back with 374 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇯🇵 Japanese. You share no language at all.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. 📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Ursula was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
The fire burns low. 3 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: European Elder — named and noted.

regDeaths.name: a soft green glow under the water
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
